title: Sugar Police
logline: The Sugar Police raid an open-plan office, confiscating muffins desk by desk, until the officer's detector reaches the one desk that passes inspection: {product} gets a salute.

world.setting: A bright open-plan office at the fictional logistics company Pellwick & Co on an ordinary Tuesday, mid-morning. A uniformed officer of the fictional Sugar Enforcement Unit conducts a completely serious raid.
world.palette: Built from the can: sky-blue carpet tiles and chairs, brushed silver desks and white walls; the officer's red armband is the single loud accent.
fictional_brands: Pellwick & Co (the office, never shown as text)
Sugar Enforcement Unit (the officer's unit, never shown as text; the badge and armband stay blank)
world.rules: Every sign, monitor, badge, box and food item is blank: no writing on cakes, no printed pastry boxes, monitors show only soft abstract shapes. The only real brand is the product.

ingested.moment: the detector scans the drink on his desk and goes quiet; the officer salutes it

applied.moment: the detector scans the tube or jar on the desk (balm, sunscreen, hand cream); the officer salutes it

worn.moment: the detector sweeps his body, stops at the item he is wearing (sneakers, watch, glasses) and goes quiet; salute

handheld.moment: the gadget in his hand passes the scan (earbuds, bottle, charger); salute

carried.moment: she searches his bag and finds only the product inside, neatly packed; salute

home.moment: the raid moves to a living room; the detector passes the one item in the room (chair, lamp, blanket); salute

consumable.moment: she opens his desk drawer expecting contraband and finds the product's refill pack; salute

beats.summary: Glass doors burst open: a uniformed officer with a detector wand announces a Sugar Police raid.
Rule of three: the office freezes mid-bite, Gary is made to drop his muffin, she marches down the aisle with an armful of confiscated pastries.
She reaches Theo's desk. The detector hovers over his can and goes quiet with a soft green light. He names it.
She lowers her sunglasses and salutes the can.
The detector shrieks: she dives across the break table at a birthday cake while Theo sips, unbothered, in the foreground.
The can on his desk; a red CLEARED stamp slams down beside it; tagline.

music.brief: 70s cop-show parody: tight wah guitar, clavinet and stabbing brass, 104 bpm in E minor, drops out completely under each spoken line and punches back in between them.
Music cuts dead on the green chime; a single suspended bass note under Theo's line; one heroic brass fanfare hit on the salute.
Full cop-funk chase riff under the dive, then a hard stop on the stamp and a two-bar brass button that resolves under the tagline.
